summary.intent: Work through pending todos covering SDK encryption mode selection, BYO-IPFS staging debugging, release gate failures, and GitHub Actions deprecation warnings.
summary.outcome: Shipped four PRs: CTR encryption wired through SDK upload pipeline (#399), PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint + load test fixes (#400), release gate rewrite to search standalone desktop-e2e.yml runs (#401), and GitHub Actions Node.js 24 upgrades (#402). Resolved all automated reviewer threads on each PR.

repo: selectEncryptionMode and STREAMING_MIME_TYPES were duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — centralized into packages/sdk-core/src/encryption-mode.ts

setByoStatus() existed as a vault service method but had no controller endpoint, making BYO mode untoggleable via API — this was the real cause of register-cid 403 errors, not a 400 validation failure as the todo described
The release gate searched ci-e2e.yml orchestrator runs for desktop E2E results, but successful desktop E2E tests run as standalone desktop-e2e.yml workflows — the gate never found them

Rust build artifacts in target/ were being scanned by ESLint, producing 261 of 262 lint errors — target/ was missing from eslint.config.js ignores (src-tauri/target/** was present but not root target/**)
The todo file for sdk-uploadfile-gcm ended up in both pending/ and done/ after the merge from fix/e2e-test-failures-v2 brought in both copies
API test files systematically used jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> and then re-fetched via module.get(), losing mock method types — pattern appears across republish, tee, shares, and vault spec files
FLAC audio (audio/flac) was missing from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES in both the SDK client and streaming-crypto.service.ts
SDK test files that mock @cipherbox/sdk-core with a bare factory object silently drop all exports not explicitly listed — adding new exports to sdk-core breaks those tests
pnpm api:generate script includes a lint:fix step that lints the entire repo, causing it to fail on Rust-generated JS in target/
The load test workload was calling /ipns/publish with {ipnsName, cid} but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires {ipnsName, record, metadataCid} — the signed IPNS record was entirely missing

code.finding: New module centralizing STREAMING_MIME_TYPES, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD_BYTES, selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size), and normalizeEncryptionMode(mode)
Added optional encryptionMode param — uses encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv when 'CTR', falls back to GCM. normalizeEncryptionMode() guards invalid values
uploadFile now calls selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) imported from sdk-core before delegating to sdkCore.uploadFile
Added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint calling vaultService.setByoStatus() — previously this service method had no controller wiring
SetByoStatusDto (enable: boolean) and SetByoStatusResponseDto (isByoUser: boolean) added for the new endpoint
createByoClientPool now calls PATCH /vault/byo-status for each client after creation, filters out failed enables, and throws if zero clients succeed
ipns-publish step replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core; createSdkContext hoisted outside per-iteration loop; register-cid failures now logged with HTTP status
Desktop E2E gate rewritten to search desktop-e2e.yml runs directly, walking commits newest-first by SHA, polling in-progress runs — replaced 97-line dual-source search with 27 lines
Added target/** to ignores — was missing despite src-tauri/target/** being present, causing 261 Rust artifact lint errors
Fixed jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern — use mock objects directly instead of re-fetching via module.get() which loses mock method types. Pattern applies across republish, tee, shares, vault specs

workflow: When vi.mock('@cipherbox/sdk-core', () => ({...})) uses a bare factory, all new exports added to sdk-core silently break those tests — use importOriginal + spread instead
After adding a new export to a package, rebuild the package before typechecking dependent packages — the SDK imports compiled types from sdk-core dist
pnpm api:generate requires the API server to be running to generate the OpenAPI spec; running it writes to cwd if the output path isn't specified, causing accidental openapi.json files
GitHub Actions `gh run list` returns runs by creation time, not commit order — re-triggered runs for older commits appear newest; walk commits first and look up runs by SHA to get correct ordering
CodeRabbit and Copilot both review PRs; Copilot comments appear as REST pull request comments (not GraphQL review threads in all cases), requiring REST fallback when GraphQL times out

friction: GraphQL API for fetching review threads timed out repeatedly, requiring REST fallback to get PR comment data
accidental openapi.json written to apps/api/ (cwd) instead of packages/api-client/ during manual OpenAPI generation — had to remove it post-push
api-client generated files were not fully staged in the initial commit, causing CI drift check failure — had to add the missing model files and generated directories in a follow-up commit
.husky/commit-msg and .husky/commit-msg.pre-entire created by Entire CLI kept appearing in git status — required adding to .git/info/exclude
The todo file for the completed SDK GCM work appeared in both pending/ and done/ after merging, requiring manual cleanup
Background task for 'Fix pre-existing API test errors' ran in parallel with manual fixes — work was duplicated but not conflicting
pnpm api:generate lint step failing on Rust target/ files blocked the api:generate workflow even though the actual generation succeeded
